key_facts.reason_jp: 設立40周年を機に株主還元を強化、ValueCreation700の実現に向けた経営陣の意思表示

summary_en: ¥14.00/share (¥12.00 ordinary + ¥2.00 40th anniversary special) for FY2026/9 (up from ¥12.00 previously). Increase of ¥2.00 per share. Non-recurring special dividend component tied to 40th founding anniversary and ValueCreation700 enterprise value program.
summary_jp: 2026年9月期：1株当たり配当14円（普通12円＋記念2円）。従来予想12円から2円増加。40周年とValueCreation700達成を背景に、記念配当を実施。
